第一品 比库巴帝摩卡序论

本品中文为原书序论；英文栏为内部学习用工作译文，并非 SuttaCentral 译文。

第一品

比库巴帝摩卡序论

第一节 什么是比库巴帝摩卡

什么是比库巴帝摩卡呢？“比库巴帝摩卡”是巴利语的音译，由“比库”和“巴帝摩卡”两个词组成。
What is a Bhikkhu Pātimokkha? The “Bhikkhu Pātimokkha” is a pronunciation of Pāḷi, consisting of the words “bhikkhu” and “Pātimokkha”.
比库，巴利语bhikkhu的音译，有行乞者、穿破衣者、见怖畏等义。即于跋葛瓦的正法、律中出家并达上的男子。
bhikkhu, the voice of the Pāḷi language, bhikkhu, is that of the beggars, those who wear broken clothes, and those who see fear. That is the man who came from the law and the law of Gowa and met them.
《律藏·巴拉基格》解释说：
La Rea Barakig explained that:
“Bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu.”
"Bhikkhkako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariya'ajhupagto'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaadharao'ti bhikkhu."
“比库，即乞讨者为比库，从事集食行为者为比库，穿破衣者为比库。”(V.1.45)
“bhikkhu, the beggar, is bhikkhu, the predator is bhikkhu, and the man who wears the broken clothes is bhikkhu.” (V.1.45)
按照这种解释，“bhikkhu”一词主要是由巴利语bhikkhaka（乞讨者）或bhikkhā（集食）引申而来。
According to this interpretation, the term “bhikkhu” is mainly derived from the Pāḷi language bhikkhaka (suppliers) or bhikkhā (collectives).
根据律藏义註，这里的“乞讨者”(bhikkhako)并非像开口向人乞讨东西的穷人或乞丐，而是不管获得或没获得，皆以高贵的方式求取者。
According to the legal doctrine, the “bhikkhako” here is not like a poor or beggar who begs for something in his mouth, but rather a man who seeks it in a noble manner, whether or not he has obtained it.
“从事集食行为者”(bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato)是指捨弃了少量或大量的财富，放弃了农耕、商业等工作，出离俗家而为无家者，过着如佛陀等一般以从事收集食物的方式资养色身、维持生活的人。
“Bhikkhācariya ajhupagato” is a person who abandons a small or large amount of wealth, abandons farming, business, etc., leaves a common home and is left without a home, and lives in a way that is generally used by Buddha as a means of collecting food to support himself and his family.
穿着把价值、触感和颜色三种皆破坏之衣者为比库。用刀剪等把高价的布料进行割截、裁剪为破坏价值(agghabhedo)；用针线缝纫而使原先有乐触的布料变成粗触为破坏触感(phassabhedo)；被针锈、汗水、染料等破坏了布料的原来色泽为破坏颜色(vaṇṇabhedo)。又或者以只穿着与在家衣服有别的袈裟者为穿破衣者(bhinnapaṭadharo)。(V.A.1.45)
A cosmopolitan is used to cut and trim high-priced fabrics (agghabhedo) with knives and scissors; to sew with needles to make previously ecstasy fabric cosmopolitan (phassabhedo); to devarnish it with its original colours (va abhedo) with rust, sweat, dye, etc.; or to wear bhinnapa adharao only for those who wear something else with their home clothes.
而在《清净之道》中则说：
And in the Clean Path, it says:
“Bhikkhū'ti saṃsāre bhayaṃ ikkhaṇatāya vā bhinna- paṭadharāditāya vā evaṃ laddhavohāro saddhāpabbajito kulaputto.”
"Bhikkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkhkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk
“比库者，以看见轮回的怖畏，或以穿破衣等，获得这样名称的信心出家的良家之子。”(Vm.14)
“The son of a good family who has gained confidence in such a name by seeing the fear of his return, or by wearing broken clothes, etc.” (Vm.)
在此，“bhikkhu”一词是由巴利语bhaya（怖畏）+ ikkha（看见）组成，故以“见怖畏”之义为比库。
Here, the term “bhikkhu” is made up of the Pāḷi (bhaya) + ikkha (seen) and is thus used as a bicoco with the term “daunt”.
因此，巴利语法书《词语导论·词根鬘》(Sadda- nītippakaraṇa Dhātumālā)把“bhikkhu”分为前缀bhi（怖畏，破）加上词根ikkha（看见）进行解释：
Thus, the Pāḷi syntax book, The Introduction to Words and Roots (Sadda-nbertippakaraa Dhātumālā), divides “bhikkhu” into the prefix bhi (daunting, breaking) plus the word ikkha (seeing):
“Tathā hi kilese bhindatīti bhikkhu. Chinnabhinnapaṭa- dharotipi bhikkhu. Bhikkhanasīlotipi bhikkhu. Saṃsāre bhayaṃ ikkhati, ikkhanasīloti vā bhikkhu.”
"Thath kilese bhikkhu." Chinnabhinnapaa-dharotipi bhikkhu.
“如此，破烦恼为比库，穿割截的破衣者为比库，乞求戒者为比库，看见轮回的怖畏，或看护戒者为比库。”(p.369)
“So, the troubles are bhikkhu, the cut-downs are bhikkhu, the beggings are bhikkhu, and the fear of the return, or the caretakers are bhikkhu.” (p. 369)
巴帝摩卡，巴利语pātimokkha的音译，有最初、上首、极殊胜、极尊贵、护解脱等义。
The original, upper-head, highest-ranking, most noble, and defunct interpretation of the Pāḷi language pātimokkha.
《律藏·大品·诵戒篇》中解释：
The book "The Book of the Book" explains:
“Pātimokkhan'ti ādimetaṃ mukhametaṃ pamukham- etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, Tena vuccati pātimokkhan'ti.”
"Phatimokkhan't have a tumukham and a kusal a, Tena vuccati phatimokhan'ti."
“巴帝摩卡者，此是最初，此是头首，此是诸善法之上首，因此称为‘巴帝摩卡’。”(V.3.135)
“Badimocans, this was the beginning, this was the head, this is the top of the good laws and is therefore called `Badimoc'.” (V.3.135)
律义註《疑惑度脱》(Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī)解释说：
The law, Ka khāvitara, explains:
“Pātimokkhan'ti pa-atimokkhaṃ atipamokkhaṃ atiseṭṭhaṃ ati-uttamanti attho.”
"Pātimokkhan'ti pa-timokkha atipamokkha ati-uttamanti atho."
“巴帝摩卡为极殊胜、极上首、极尊、极上之义。”(Kv.p.84)
“Badimocca is a great victory, top of the top, top of the top, top of the top.” (Kv.p.84)
按照这种解释，“pātimokkha”一词是由巴利语pa-ati（极）+ mokkha（殊胜），或由ati（极）+ pāmokkha（上首）组成，故以“极殊胜，极上首”等义为巴帝摩卡。
According to this interpretation, the term “pātimokkha” is made up of the Pāḷi pa-ati (extreme)+mokkha (severe victory) or the ati (extreme)+pāmokkha (head) so that the term “extreme victory” is used to refer to Batimoca.
该义註接着又说：
The note goes on to say:
“Tattha sīlaṃ yo naṃ pāti rakkhati, taṃ mokkheti mocayati āpāyikādīhi dukkhehi, attānuvādādīhi vā bhayehī'ti pātimokkhaṃ.”
"Tattha's rakkhati, mochayati's kakkakhhi, kokhhi, kokhhi"
“其中的戒是若看护、保护此者，能解脱、脱离恶趣等苦，或者自责等怖畏，故为巴帝摩卡。”(Kv.p.84; 参考Vm.14)
“Absolutely, it is Batiamocca if he is in the care or protection of such a person, free from evil or fear, or blame himself.” (Kv.p. 84; cf. Vm.)
在此，“pātimokkha”一词是由巴利语pāti（看护）+ mokkha（解脱）组成，故以“护解脱”之义为巴帝摩卡。
Here, the term “pātimokkha” consists of the Pāḷi language pāti (care)+mokkha (resolve) and therefore the term “resolve” is used as the term “defunct” in the name of Badimoca.
因为“巴帝摩卡”含有多义，所以通常采用音译，必要时才意译为“护解脱”。
Because of the multidimensional nature of the “Badymocca”, it is common to use a sound translation, which is meant to be “resolved” when necessary.

第二节 巴帝摩卡的分类

“巴帝摩卡”依表现形式可以分为戒巴帝摩卡和经籍巴帝摩卡两种：
"Badimocca" can be distinguished by the following: "Badimocca" and "Badimocca":
1. 戒巴帝摩卡(sīla pātimokkha)——即通过看护而解脱恶趣等苦与自责等怖畏的戒。
The sbela pātimokkha — a fear of pain and self-responsibility through care.
2. 经籍巴帝摩卡(gantha pātimokkha)——即僧团每半月半月念诵的戒经，分为《比库巴帝摩卡》和《比库尼巴帝摩卡》两部戒经。(Kv.p.84)
The Bhatha pātimokkha, which is the religion of the monks, is divided into Bikubadimoca and Bikuni Badimokha. (Kv.p.84).
“巴帝摩卡”又依所受持之众可以分为比库巴帝摩卡和比库尼巴帝摩卡两种：
“Badimoca” can be divided into two groups: Bikubadimoca and Bikuni Badimoca:
1. 比库巴帝摩卡(bhikkhupātimokkha)——比库应持守的巴帝摩卡防护戒，共有227学处。
Bikhupātimokkha - Batimoka protective ring to be maintained by Biku, with a total of 227 schools.
2. 比库尼巴帝摩卡(bhikkhunīpātimokkha)——比库尼应持守的巴帝摩卡防护戒，共有311学处。
Bikuni Badimokka (bhikkhunbepātimokkha) — the Batimoka protective ring that Bikuni is supposed to maintain, with a total of 311 schools.
“巴帝摩卡”还可以依诵者而分为教诲巴帝摩卡和威令巴帝摩卡两种：
"Badymocca" can also be divided into two categories of preachers: Buddymocca and Wiedomocca:
1. 教诲巴帝摩卡(ovādapātimokkha)——只是由“忍耐是最高苦行”等三首偈颂组成，而且只是由诸佛诵出，并非由弟子在各自的寺院诵出。这是佛陀尚未为弟子制定学处时，整个瞻部洲(Jambudīpa, 印度)的所有比库僧团于某一时齐集佛陀之处，由佛陀向他们诵出的巴帝摩卡。
The teaching of Batiamoka - consisting only of three hymns, such as “destroyance is the supreme cause of suffering” - was only recited by the Buddha, not by his disciples in their respective monasteries. This was Batamoka when Buddha had not yet set up a school for his disciples, and all the Biku monks from the whole of the Foresee continent (Jambudbépa, India) were at a time when they had been recited to them by Buddha.
2.威令巴帝摩卡(āṇāpātimokkha)——自从佛陀为弟子制定学处以後，即由弟子僧团每半月半月齐集于各自居住的寺院所念诵的巴帝摩卡。(V.A.1.19)
Widden Badimokkha - Batimuka, which has been read by the monks and nuns of Buddha for half a month and a half at the monasteries where they live since Buddha set up the school. (V.A.1.19)
以上三种分类中，戒即是巴帝摩卡，而经籍巴帝摩卡包括《比库巴帝摩卡》和《比库尼巴帝摩卡》两部戒经，它们皆属于威令巴帝摩卡。而教诲巴帝摩卡只是专由诸佛所诵出的巴帝摩卡。
Of these three categories, the ban is Batiamoka, which is composed of Bikubadimoka and BikuniBadimocca, all of which belong to Wiobadimocca. The teaching of Batiamocca is just that read by the Buddhas.

第三节 巴帝摩卡的制定

制定包括巴帝摩卡在内的诸学处是拥有一切知智(sabbaññutā-ñāṇa)的正自觉者(sammā-sambuddha)的范畴，而不是其他诸如天人、人类、梵天、沙门、婆罗门等的能力范围，即使像沙利子(Sāriputta)尊者如此智慧第一的上首弟子(aggasāvaka)、伍巴离(Upāli)尊者如此持律第一的大弟子(mahāsāvaka)，都没有制戒的权限。
The schools, including Badimokka, were designed to be the realm of all sabbañutā-sambuddhas (sammā-sambuddha) and not other areas of competence such as heaven, mankind, Brahma, Salmon, Brahma, and so many others, even though the upper cousins of Sāriputta (aggrasāvaka) and Upāli (Upāli) were so well-versed masters of the law have no right to restrain.
在佛陀跋葛瓦弘法的最初二十年中，由于前来请求出家的人普遍动机纯正，僧团中还没有污垢法出现，所以佛陀跋葛瓦并没有为诸弟子们制定诸多的学处。当时，佛陀只是以“教诲巴帝摩卡”(Ovāda- pātimokkha)教导比库们。此“教诲巴帝摩卡”如下：
In the first two decades of the Buddha region, since the general motives of the people who came to ask for a home were pure and there was no dirt in the monks, the Buddhist region did not have many schools for the disciples. At that time, the Buddha taught Bikus “Ovāda-pātimokkha” as follows:
Khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā,
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, but I'm sorry.
nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā.
I'm not going to leave you alone. I'm not going to leave you.
Na hi pabbajito parūpaghātī,
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.
I'm not going anywhere. I'm not going anywhere. I'm not going anywhere.
Sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ,
Sabbapāpassa akara ,
kusalassa upasampadā.
I'm sorry, folks.
Sacittapariyodapanaṃ,
Sacittapariyodapana.
etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
It's not like I'm gonna be able to do this.
Anūpavādo anūpaghāto,
It's not like I'm going to be able to do that.
pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro;
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
Mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ,
I don't know what you're talking about.
pantañca sayanāsanaṃ.
I'm sorry, ma'am.
Adhicitte ca āyogo,
Adhicitte caayogo.
etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
It's not like I'm gonna be able to do this.
“忍耐是最高苦行，
“Holdurance is the highest form of suffering.
诸佛说涅槃最上；
And the Zhufu says, "The best of all,
恼他实非出家人，
The blogger adds that he is not a member of his family.
害他者不是沙门。
It's not Salmon who did this to the others.
莫作诸恶，
And do not do evil,
具足于善；
Be good enough;
净化自心，
I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to do this.
此诸佛教。
The Buddhists.
不责不恼害，
I don't blame anyone.
护巴帝摩卡；
(b) Protecting Badimocca;
于食知节量，
And by the measure of food,
居边远住处；
(b) Remote accommodation;
致力增上心，
It's not like we're going to be able to do this.
此是诸佛教。”(D.2.90; Dhp.183-5; V.A.1.19)
This is Buddhism.” (D.2.90; Dhp. 183-5; V.A.1.19)
据《律藏》记载，佛陀跋葛瓦在证悟正自觉後的第十二年，住在韦沙离城(Vesālī)的韦兰迦村(Verañjā)度雨安居。在那时，上首弟子沙利子基于令佛陀教法久住的原因而希望跋葛瓦为弟子们制定学处，跋葛瓦说在僧团中还未出现有漏法之前不会为弟子们制定学处，诵巴帝摩卡。律中说：
According to the Book, the village of Verañjā, in Vesālbe, lived in a rain in the twelfth year of Buddha's Guwa, after she had become aware of it. At that time, his first son, Sally, hoped that he would set up a school for his disciples for the reason that he had long lived in Buddha's religion, and Gueva said that he would not set up a school for his disciples until there had been a leak in the monks.
“那时，具寿沙利子到僻静处独坐，心生如此想法:‘哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住?’
“And then, when the sharikos sat alone in the middle of nowhere, they thought, “What is the Brahma in Buddha's Gewa that can't stay? Which Brahma in Buddha's Gewa can stay?”
当时，具寿沙利子在傍晚时分从禅坐起来，前往跋葛瓦之处。来到之後，顶礼跋葛瓦，坐在一边。坐在一边的具寿沙利子对跋葛瓦这样说：
And when he sat at night from Zen to Gowa's place, when he came, he sat at one side of the top of the Zone, and the one who sat at the other said to Gowa:
‘尊者，在此，我到僻静处独坐，心生如此想法:‘哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住?’尊者，哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行不能久住？哪一位佛陀跋葛瓦的梵行能久住呢?’
`The Lord, I sit in a place of silence, and I wonder: `Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? Which Brahma in the Buddha's District? Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? Who is the Brahma in the Buddha's District? What is the Brahma in the Buddha's District?
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦维巴西(Vipassī)、跋葛瓦西奇(Sikhī)和跋葛瓦韦思菩(Vessabhu)的梵行不能久住。沙利子，跋葛瓦咖古三特(Kakusandha)、跋葛瓦果那葛马那(Konāgamana)和跋葛瓦咖沙巴(Kassapa)的梵行能久住。’
‘Shariko, the Brahma in Vipassbé, Sikhbé and Vessabhu in the region, cannot last long. The Brahma in the regions of Kakusandha, Konāgamana in the district of Guwago, and Kassapa will last.’
‘尊者，是何因何缘，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩的梵行不能久住呢?’
‘Why does the Lord, the Brahma of Gwawi Brazil, Gwacic and Gwaways not last?’
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩因疲劳为诸弟子详细说法，他们只有少量的经、应颂、记说、偈颂、感慨、如是语、本生、未曾有法与智得，不为诸弟子制定学处，不诵巴帝摩卡。当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行迅速消失。
‘Shariko, the Buddhas of Guavibba, Guwasiche and Guvaves, who are tired and tired, have only a small number of scriptures, hymns, memoirs, hymns, emotions, words, instincts, and wisdom, and have not developed a school for their students, and do not recite Pātimokkha. When the Buddhas of Guwa entered, the followers of Buddha’s remembrance went to their homes with different names, different names, different origins, and different races, and they quickly disappeared.
沙利子，犹如不同的花放在木板上，不用线串在一起，那风一吹就飘散、分散、破碎。那是何因呢？它们没有被线串在一起故。同样地，沙利子，当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行迅速消失。
As different flowers are placed on a plank, without a thread, the wind is scattered, scattered and broken. And why is that? And likewise, when the Buddha's guava was extinguished, the followers of Buddha's remembrance came to their homes with different names, different names, different origins, different races, and they quickly disappeared from their vanity.
又那些跋葛瓦疲劳以心查知弟子们之心。沙利子，过去韦思菩跋葛瓦、阿拉汉、正自觉者曾在一座恐怖的密林中，以心查知一千位比库僧之心，教诲、教诫[说]：应如此思惟，不应如此思惟；应如此作意，不应如此作意；应捨断此，应成就此而住。’沙利子，当时那一千位比库在韦思菩跋葛瓦、阿拉汉、正自觉者如此教诲、如此教诫时，心无执取而从诸漏解脱。沙利子，那座恐怖密林确实恐怖，若有未离贪者进入该密林，大多数皆毛骨悚然。沙利子，乃是此因此缘，跋葛瓦维巴西、跋葛瓦西奇和跋葛瓦韦思菩的梵行不能久住。’
And those who were tired and tired of Gowa should know the hearts of their disciples. The Saliko, who was in the past in the Wess Buddha's Land of Gowa, Arahan, and those who were conscious of themselves, had found out the heart of a thousand Biku monks in a terrible forest, taught and taught [said]: "Thus should be thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, not so thought, and so should be done. "Sharako, that was why the 1,000 Bikus who were so taught by Gowa, Alahan, and those who were conscious of their own will, could not live long in the vanilla of Gwazi, Gwazi and Gwawess. "
‘尊者，又是何因何缘，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那葛马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴的梵行能久住呢?’
‘What is the reason why the Sanctuary of Gorwagaku, Gewago, Gormana, and Gwadagashaba can live long?’
‘沙利子，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那葛马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴不疲劳为诸弟子详细说法，他们[宣说]很多的经、应颂、记说、偈颂、感慨、如是语、本生、未曾有法与智得，为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡。当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行长时住立。
‘Shariko, who has not been tired of saying it for the students, [declare] many scriptures, hymns, hymns, hymns, hymns, feelings, such as words, instincts, not having any knowledge or knowledge, set up schools for the students and recited Badimocca. When the Buddha’s Quails were destroyed, the followers of Buddha’s Zhuts came to their homes by different names, surnames, origins, and races, and they made their chiefs live.’
沙利子，犹如不同的花放在木板上，用线串在一起，那风吹也不会飘散、分散、破碎。那是何因呢？它们被线串在一起故。同样地，沙利子，当那些佛陀跋葛瓦入灭後，随佛觉悟的诸弟子入灭後，那些後来的弟子由不同名、不同姓、不同出身、不同种族出家，他们使其梵行长时住立。沙利子，乃是此因此缘，跋葛瓦咖古三特、跋葛瓦果那格马那和跋葛瓦咖沙巴的梵行能久住。’
As different flowers are placed on a plank, the wind will not be scattered, scattered and broken. That is why. Likewise, the Shaleys, when the Buddha's guavas were destroyed, the followers of the Buddha's remembrance came to their homes with their names and surnames, their origins, their races, and they kept their fascists at home. That is why the Shaleys, for that reason, were able to live in the Sanskrits of Gwat, Gwagonamana and Zhuvatwat shabah.
当时，具寿沙利子即从座起，将上衣披于一肩，合掌礼敬跋葛瓦後，对跋葛瓦这样说：‘尊者，现在是时候了！善至，现在是时候了！愿跋葛瓦为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，如此使此梵行长久住立。’
At that time, after the birth of the Shari'a, who had put his shirt on his shoulder, and had taken over the Gwa, he said to the Gwa: "The time has come! The time has come! The time has come! The time has come! The Bhatta has set up a school for the sons, and the Bhadimaka has been recited, thus perpetuating the Bhattamaka."
‘你且等等，沙利子。你且等等，沙利子。如来将知其时。沙利子，只要在此某些有害之法尚未出现于僧团中，导师就不会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡。沙利子，只要在此某些有害之法出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
‘You wait, Shariko. You wait, Shariko. If you come to know, then the coaches will not set up a school and recite Pātimokkha for the students as long as some of the harmful laws have not yet appeared in the monks. The coaches will not create a school and recite the harmful ones until some of the harmful ones have appeared in the monks.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到阅历深者庞大之前，在此某些有害之法就还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到阅历深者庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
As long as the monks have not reached their depths, some harmful laws will not appear in the monks. Only when the monks have reached their depths will some harmful laws be found in the monks, then the mentors will be able to draw up a school for the students and recite the Pātimokkha in order to eliminate the harmful laws.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到富裕庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到富裕庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
As long as the monks are not rich enough, some of the harmful laws will not appear in the monks. Only when the monks are rich enough will some of the harmful laws be found in the monks, then the mentors will set up a school for the students and recite the Batiamoka in order to eliminate the harmful laws.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到利得极丰庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团利得极丰庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为诸弟子制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
Shariko, as long as the monks have not earned a great deal of money, some of these harmful laws will not appear in the monks. Only after the monks have earned a great deal will some of these harmful laws appear in the monks, so that the mentors will develop a school for the students and recite the Batiamoka in order to eliminate them.
沙利子，只要僧团尚未达到多闻者庞大之前，在此某些有害之法还不会出现于僧团中。沙利子，只有僧团达到多闻者庞大後，在此某些有害之法才会出现于僧团中，那时导师才会为弟子们制定学处、诵巴帝摩卡，以便消除那些有害之法。
As long as the monasteries are not as large as they are, some harmful laws will not appear in the monasteries. Only when the monasteries are as large as they are, some harmful laws will appear in the monasteries, and then the mentors will create a school and recite Batiamoka for the students in order to eliminate the harmful laws.
沙利子，比库僧团实无秽垢、无过患、离污浊、清净，安立心要。沙利子，此五百比库中，连最後的比库也是入流者，无堕处法，必定趣向正觉。’”(V.1.18-21)
Shariko, the Monk of bhikkhu, is free of filth, no ills, no defilement, cleanness, and peace of mind. Shariko, in this 500-bit bank, even the last of the piku, is in the flow, and there is no law against it, and it must be positive.’” (V.1.18-21)
佛陀跋葛瓦住在韦沙离城大林(Mahāvana)的尖顶阁堂(Kūṭāgārasālā)。其时咖兰德村(Kalandagāma)的富豪子苏定那·咖兰德子(Sudinna Kalandaputta)闻佛说法，生起信心，请求出家，但父母坚决不允。苏定那乃采用绝食的方法，最终迫使其父母勉强答应。苏定那在跋葛瓦跟前出家并达上後，受持诸头陀行，并住在瓦基(Vajjī)的一个村庄。
In the village of Kalandagāma, Sudinna Kalandaputta, a rich man who heard Buddha's story, raised confidence and asked to leave the house, but his parents refused to accept it. Sutena used hunger strike, eventually forcing his parents to refuse to accept it. Sutena was in the village of Kalandagāma, where he was driven to his home and lived in Vajjjbe.
有一次，瓦基发生饥馑，集食难得，具寿苏定那回乡托钵，被亲戚家的婢女认出。其父母知道後，邀请他次日回家应供。次日，其父母出示家财，诱劝具寿苏定那还俗，但再三不获其允，于是改求续种（子嗣）：“亲爱的苏定那啊！此家富有，大富大贵，多金银、多财物、多资产。亲爱的苏定那，那就请给予子嗣吧！不要让离差族人因为我们无子而没收财产。”具寿苏定那答应所求。其母携其前妻到大林中，由于当时跋葛瓦尚未制定学处，未能见到过患，于是苏定那和其前妻三次行淫欲法，他成为无秽垢、无过患的比库僧团中的最初犯戒者。
On one occasion, Waki went hungry and gathered food, and returned to the village of Sudina, where he was recognized by the handmaidens of his relatives. When his parents knew, they invited him home to give their things the next day. The next day, his parents showed their family's wealth and persuaded him to marry Sudina, but they did not receive their consent, so they sought a new seed. “O dear Sudina! This family was rich and rich, rich and rich, rich and rich, rich and rich, and rich in wealth and wealth. Then give son to him, and do not allow the separated people to confiscate their property because we had no sons.” Sudunna promised. His mother brought his former wife to the Great Forest, because he had not been able to attend school and had not been able to see it.
苏定那的前妻因此有了身孕，不久生了个儿子，朋友们叫他“续种”(Bījaka)，称其母为“续种母”，称苏定那为“续种父”。之後，母子俩皆出家并证得阿拉汉。
As a result, the ex-wife of Sudina became pregnant and soon gave birth to a son, who was called the “Bbijaka” by his friends, who called his mother the “reinherited mother” and the “reinherited father” of Sudiná.
具寿苏定那事後常怀忧悔，告诉比库们，比库们种种呵责後报告跋葛瓦。跋葛瓦集合僧众审问具寿苏定那，以种种方式呵责後，制定了第一条学处：
After the events of Sudmin, he told Bicos that after all their culpability, he had reported to Gwa. The monks gathered in Gwa to question Sudina and, after all their culpability, set up the first school:
“若比库从事淫欲法者，是巴拉基格，不共住。”
“The man who committed the lewdness of Abigail is Barakig, who does not live together.”
跋葛瓦从此开始为比库们制定学处。(V.1.24-39)
From that point on, a school for Bikus was set up (V.1.24-39).
此後，随着僧团规模的不断扩大，僧人成份的不断复杂，在僧团中的不良现象和不良分子也逐渐增多。每当僧团出现污垢，或者比库们发生不适当的行为时，佛陀跋葛瓦就此因缘而制定了相应的学处。当制定的学处达到一定数量时，便编集成《巴帝摩卡》。
Since then, with the growing size of the monasteries, their complex composition has been increasing, as have ills and undesirables in the monasteries. Whenever there is dirt in the monasteries, or when there is an inappropriate behavior by the monks, the Gavas of the Buddha's district has developed a corresponding school.

第四节 制定巴帝摩卡的意义

佛陀跋葛瓦制定学处的一般过程是：僧团中有某位或某些比库发生不适当的行为，引起在家人的讥嫌、非议，比库们听到在家人的讥嫌、非议，其中的少欲者也讥嫌、非议。那些比库们以种种方法呵责後，将此事报告跋葛瓦。跋葛瓦因此集合僧众，将当事人叫到跟前查问。当事人承认事实後，跋葛瓦以种种方法呵责他，并申明制定学处的十项意义，然後制定学处：
The general process in the design of the Fato Gwa school is that one of the monks or some of them behaved inappropriately, causing sarcasm and controversy in his family, and that he heard in his family, and that he was sarcastic and scoffing. Those who were sarcastic, then reported the matter to him by various means. As a result, the monks gathered together to call him to question him. When he admitted the facts, he blamed him in every way, and affirmed the ten meanings of the scaffolding, and then set up a place for study:
“Tena hi, Bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca - Saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṇkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinayānuggahāya.”
“Tena, Bhikkhave, and Zikkhanga, Zakkhama, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zabra, Zabra, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Zahara, Za, Zahara, Zia, Zia, Zia, Zia, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za and Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za, Za
“诸比库，缘于十种 义利，我为比库们制定学处：为了僧团的优越，为了僧团的安乐；为了折服无耻之人，为了善行比库们的安住；为了防护现法诸漏，为了防止後世诸漏；为了无信者生信，为了已信者增长；为了正法住立，为了资益于律。”(V.1.39)
“The Pickus, for the ten types of Italians, I have set up schools for the Bicos: for the benefit of the monks, for the comfort of the monks, for the sake of the shameless, for the sake of the betterment of the Bicoons, for the protection of the law, for the protection of the future, for the sake of the faithless, for the growth of the faithful, for the sake of the law, for the benefit of the law.” (V.1.39)
律藏的义註《普端严》解释了这十种义利：
The law's motto, Generality, explains the ten types of philanthropy:
⑴僧团的优越：即是僧团的优越状态。凡是领受如来之语者，即能为他带来长久的利益、快乐，对于僧众们[回答]“好的，尊者!”来领受我的话而我将制定[学处]，并见到了不领受的过患以及领受的功德，而不是使用强硬手段，因此才这样显示说“为了僧团的优越”。
(1) The upper hand of the monks: that is, the upper hand of the monks. Anyone who receives a good word can bring him long-term benefit, happiness, and to the monks [responding] “good, honoured!” to receive my words, and I will make it clear that I have seen the pains and virtues of the monks, rather than using hard-line means, “for the benefit of the monks”.
⑵僧团的安乐：即是僧团安乐的状态。为了共同生活在一起者能够快乐地安住的意思。
(2) The rest of the monks: the rest of the monks. It means that those who live together can live happily.
⑶为了折服无耻之人：无耻即是恶戒之人。即使对那些觉得羞耻的、会陷入痛苦的事，他在违犯时或做了也不会羞愧，为了折服他们。在没有学处时，他们会说“你们见到了什么？听到了什么？我们做了什么？凭哪件事、哪条罪来斥责我?”来扰乱僧团。但有了学处，僧团便可令他们见到学处而用法、律、导师之教来折服。以此故说：为了折服无耻之人。
"What have you seen? What have we done? What have we done?" In order to disturb the monks. But with a place of study, the monks can bring them to school with the teachings of law, law and guidance. Thus they say, "To disparage the impudent."
⑷为了善行比库们的安住：为了善行、喜戒的比库们能够安乐住。若喜戒的比库不知道应作、不应作，有过失、无过失，界限和规则，在为圆满三学努力时感到疲劳，有疑问时感到苦恼。但若知道应作、不应作，有过失、无过失，界限和规则，在为圆满三学努力时不会疲劳，有疑问时不会苦恼。为他们制定学处则能导向安乐住。又或者折服了无耻之人，他们才能安乐住。若依止恶行之人，则不能行诵戒、不能作邀请、不能举行僧甘马，也不能和合，比库们不能专一地教导、询问和实践业处等。但折服了恶行者则没有这一切祸害，从而使善行比库们能安乐住。如此，当知“为了善行比库们的安住”有这两种意思。
(4) For the sake of the peace of the bicoons: for the sake of good deeds, and for the sake of joy, the bicoons can live in peace. If Bico knows not what should be done, and should not be done, and there is no fault, no fault, boundaries and rules, he is tired and troubled in his efforts for the success of the three studies. But if he knows what should be done, should not be done, and there is no fault, no fault, no boundaries and rules, he does not fatigue himself in his efforts to complete the three studies, and in his doubt, he guides them in peace. If he does not know what to do with the evil, then he cannot recite, invite, or hold the monks and horses together. But the Bicoons cannot teach, interrogate, interrogate, etc. But there is no such evil in their deeds, so that they may live well with the betters.
⑸为了防护现法诸漏：现法诸漏即是因为不防护而使自身遭受到的拳打、棒打、砍手、砍脚、名声败坏、懊悔等痛苦。如是为了防护、避免、预防这些今生的灾患。
(5) In order to protect themselves against the current law: the present law is the pain of beating, beating, cutting hands, cutting feet, discrediting reputations, regret, and so on. It is to protect, prevent, and prevent these present-day disasters.
⑹为了防止後世诸漏：後世诸漏即是因为不防护而作了恶业之因，使後世遭受地狱等的痛苦。乃是为了消除、止灭、避免这些而说。
(6) In order to prevent the lapses of the hereafter, which are the cause of the evil that has been done in an unprotected manner, the torment of the hereafter, etc., is to be said in order to eliminate, eliminate, and avoid them.
⑺为了无信者生信：有了学处的制定，那些无信心但却知道学处的制定、或者见到比库们遵照学处而行的智者们会说：“对于世间上大多数人染着、秽恶、愚昧之事，这些沙门释迦子却能远离、离而安住，他们确实行难行之行，确实行重大之行。”从而生起信心，就像看了律藏後的邪见者三吠陀婆罗门一样。所以说“为了无信者生信”。
(7) For the sake of the faithless: those wise men who have no confidence in its design but know its design, or who have seen Bikus follow it, will say: “For most people in the world who are exposed to it, they are obstinate and ignorant, and who are able to live far away and far away, they are indeed going hard to do it and do great things.” Thus, confidence is created, as is the case of the phantom of the phantom after the treachery. So it is said: “For the faithless, believe.”
⑻为了已信者增长：那些对佛教有信心的善男子知道了学处的制定，或见到比库们遵照学处而行时会说：“啊，这些聖尊是难行能行者，他们终生只吃一餐、行梵行、持守戒律防护。”从而信心越来越增长。以此故说“为了已信者增长”。
(8) For the sake of faith growth: good men who have faith in Buddhism know about the establishment of the Academy, or when they see Bikus following it, they say, “Ah, these saints are the hard-to-go, they eat only one meal in their lifetime, they practice the Brahma, and they keep the law and the law.” So confidence grows. Thus, “For the sake of the faith grow”, he says.
⑼为了正法住立：有三种正法：教正法(pariyatti saddhamma)、行正法(paṭipattisaddhamma)与证正法(adhigamasaddhamma)。在此，收录于三藏中的一切佛语名为“教正法”。十三种头陀功德、十四行仪、八十二大行仪，以及戒、定、观慧名为“行正法”。四种聖道、四种沙门果以及涅槃名为“证正法”。这一切都是因为有了学处的制定，比库们才能研习学处及其分别的义理、释义，连同其他佛语，并依所制定的学处修行。圆满行道後，因行道而证得应证悟的出世间法。所以，因制定了学处，才使正法得以长久地住立。以此故说“为了正法住立”。
(9) For the sake of justice, there are three kinds of due process: pariyatti saddhamma, papiapattisadhamma, and dhigamasadhamma. Here, all the Buddhists in the three collections are listed as “proprietary law”. After a successful journey, the teachings of Dakodeh, the fourteenth and eighty-two rituals, as well as the observances, discipline and visions are called “proper law”. Four halls of law, four samengos and Neine are called “probative law”. All of this is due to the development of the science department, which enables the Bikus to study the science department and its respective ethos, together with other Buddhists, and to follow the teachings they have developed.
⑽为了资益于律：有了学处的制定，可以资益、支持、巩固防护律、捨断律、止律和制定律四种律，以此故说“为了资益于律”。
(10) For the benefit of the law: With the creation of a school, it is possible to benefit, support, strengthen the law of protection, break, stop and make four laws, thus saying “for the benefit of the law”.
所有诸句皆可结合“我将制定学处”这一语。比如第一句和最後一句可组合为：“为了僧团的优越，我将制定学处；为了资益于律，我将制定学处。”
All the words can be combined with the words “I will set the school house”. For example, the first sentence and the last sentence can be combined to read: “I will set the school house for the benefit of the monks; I will set the school house for the benefit of the law.”
此外也可用“僧团的优越即是僧团的安乐；僧团的安乐即能折服无耻之人”等环环相扣的方法，如此以“僧团的优越即是僧团的安乐；僧团的安乐即能折服无耻之人”等每一句为基础而连结十次。
It can also be linked ten times, on the basis of each sentence, such as “the upper hand of the monks, i.e. the comfort of the monks, the comfort of the monks, the comfort of the shameless”, and so on.

第五节 比库巴帝摩卡的内容

在聖典中，跋葛瓦谈到持戒时经常这样强调：
In the Bible, the Zhu Guevat, when speaking of the observance, has often stressed the following:
“Sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharatha sampanna- pātimokkhā, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha, ācāragocarasampannā, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino; samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.”
"Sampannasby, bhikkhave, viharatha sampanna-pātimokka, pātimokkasa varasasa vut viharatha, a vajjesu bhayadasāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu."
“诸比库，要具足戒与具足巴帝摩卡而住，防护巴帝摩卡防护、具足正行与行处而住，见到微细罪过的危险，受持诸学处而学。”
“The Piccos, who live with their feet of footpadmocca, who are protected against it, who live with their feet and feet, who see the dangers of minor sins and who learn from their schools.”
在《清净之道》中也提到，作为禅修基础的戒清净包括四种清净戒：
It is also mentioned in the Clean News that the clean-up, which forms the basis of rehab, consists of four clean-up measures:
1. 巴帝摩卡防护戒(pātimokkhasaṃvara-sīla)，即比库应当守护的各种学处、律仪。
1. The Batimoka protective ring (pātimokkhasa vara-sbela), i.e. the branches and instruments that Biku shall guard.
2. 根防护戒(indriyasaṃvara-sīla)，根即感官；守护好眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意六根门称为根防护。
2. Roots (indriyasa vara-sbela), which are sensory; the guard eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and six doors are referred to as root protection.
3. 活命清净戒(ājīvapārisuddhi-sīla)，即依正命（正确的谋生方式）而活，不能邪命自活。
3. A life-free (ājbevapārisuddhi-sbella) is a life-right (the right way to earn a living) and cannot live by evil.
4. 资具依止戒(paccayasannissita-sīla)，即正确、适当地使用生活必需品，包括袈裟、饮食、住所、医药等生活用品。
4. Capital-dependent (paccayasanissisita-sbela), i.e. the proper and appropriate use of essential necessities of life, including food, food, shelter, medicine, etc.
因此，巴帝摩卡属于比库的主要学处之一。
As a result, Batiamuka is one of the main departments of Bico.
这里的“学处”，巴利语sikkhāpada，又译作学足。sikkhā意为学、学习、训练；pada意为足、处所。学处亦即是学习规则、行为规范、戒条。
This is the “school office” in Pāḷi, where you translate it. Sikkhā for study, study, training, and pada for school.
在《小诵义註》中说：
In the Little Recitation, it says:
“Sikkhitabbā'ti sikkhā, pajjate anenāti padaṃ. Sikkhāya padaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ, sikkhāya adhigamūpāyoti attho. Atha vā mūlaṃ nissayo patiṭṭhāti vuttaṃ hoti.”
"Sikkhitabb's sikkkkab, pajjate anxa."
“应当学故为学；以此作为足故为足。学之足为学足，即到达学的方法之义。又或者说为根本、依止、立足处[为学处]。”(Khp.A.p.15)
“Students should be learned for good; they should be sufficient. The learning should be sufficient, i.e. the means of reaching it. Or fundamental, stop and [suspension].” (Khp.A.p. 15)
比库巴帝摩卡一共包括227条学处。这些学处又可以分为八法，即：
There are 227 schools in Bicobaltemocca.
1. 巴拉基格法：4条；
1. Barakig Law: four articles;
2. 桑喀地谢思法：13条；
2. Sankadzesian method: 13;
3. 不定法：2条；
3. Uncertainty: article 2;
4. 尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚法：30条；
4. Nisadia Bagitia: 30 articles;
5. 巴吉帝亚法：92条；
5. Bagitia: 92;
6. 应悔过法：4条；
6. Repentable law: 4;
7. 应学法：75条；
7. Acte d ' études: 75;
8. 止争法：7条。
8. Compromise law: article 7.
一、巴拉基格
I. BALakig
巴拉基格：巴利语pārājika的音译，梵语同。直译为“他胜”，意为已被打败或失败。
Barakig: The translation of the Pāḷi language pārājika is the same in Sanskrit. The translation is “He wins”, meaning that he has been defeated or failed.
在《巴拉基格》中说：
In Barakig, it says:
“Pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathāpi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sasīrabandhanena jīvituṃ, evameva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. Tena vuccati - pārājiko hotī'ti.”
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
“是巴拉基格者，犹如有人的头被砍断了，不可能再和他的身体连接而活命。同样地，比库从事淫欲法後，即非沙门、非释迦子。因此称为巴拉基格。”(V.1.55)
“It is the Barakig who, like some whose heads have been cut off, is no longer able to live with his body. Likewise, Biku, after engaging in lewdness, i.e., the non-salmons and the unresolved garbs, is called Barakig.” (V.1.55)
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:
“Pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ.
"I've got a lot of work to do.
cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato;
I don't know what to do with it.
saṃvāsopi tahiṃ natthi, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
I don't know.
“所谓‘巴拉基格’者，请听如实说：
“Accord to the words of the so-called `Barakig':
从正法中死去、失败、堕落和弃绝，
The death, failure, corruption and rejection of the law are the most serious crimes in the world.
不与他共住，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
Do not live with him, so say so.” (V.5.339)
巴拉基格相当于比库的极刑。在《大分别》中把巴拉基格比喻为断了头之人不可能再和身体接合而活命、枯叶从树枝上飘落後不可能再变回绿叶、石头破成两块就无法再复合、棕榈树的顶部被砍断了就无法再生长。同样地，凡比库违犯了此学处即自动丧失比库的身份，并且不得与僧团共住，当生也不能再受戒成为比库。若违犯者不隐瞒自己的过失，在违犯之後立刻脱掉袈裟，换成俗人的衣服，将来若想再出家，还可以受戒成为沙马内勒；然而，如果他在犯了巴拉基格罪後仍然继续保持原来的形象，冒充为比库，则他既不是比库，当生也不能再出家。
Barakig is equivalent to Biku’s capital punishment. In the Big Separates, it is not possible for a man whose head is broken to live with his body, whose leaves fall from a branch of the tree, whose leaves cannot become green again, whose stones break into two pieces, and whose palm tree top is cut off. Similarly, if he violates this school, he automatically loses his identity, and is not allowed to live with the monks, nor is he allowed to live with it.
共有四条巴拉基格罪：
There are four counts of Barakig:
1. 淫欲法
1. Act of lust
2. 不与取
2. Disconnection
3. 故意杀人
3. Deliberate homicide
4. 说虚妄的上人法。
4. Saying false pretences.
假如一位比库和人或动物发生性行为，或偷盗价值为五马萨（māsaka,古印度的货币单位）或以上的物品，或故意杀人，或以欺骗之心说了虚假的上人法，他即犯了巴拉基格。
If a Bico had sex with a man or an animal, or had stolen items with a value of five Massa (māsaka, the money unit of ancient India) or more, or had deliberately killed a person, or had lied about the law of the man in a deceitful spirit, he would have committed a crime against Barakig.
二、桑喀地谢思
II. SANCAR DISAIS
桑喀地谢思：巴利语saṅghādisesa的音译，直译作“僧始终”。其由saṅgha（僧团）+ ādi（最初；开始；首先）+ sesa（残馀；剩馀；剩下）三词组合而成。意谓犯了此一类学处的比库，对其罪的处理过程自始至终皆须由僧团来执行。
Sankadesh: The sound of the Pāḷi language saghādisesa is translated directly as “the monk always”. It is made up of sa gha (the monk) + ādi (initial; beginning; first) + sesa (disabling; remaining; remaining). It means that the crime of this type of school must be dealt with by the monks from the beginning to the end.
在《大分别》中解释说：
In the Major Division it is explained that:
“Saṅghādiseso'ti saṅghova tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti, mūlāya paṭikassati deti, mānattaṃ deti, abbheti; na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. Tena vuccati - saṅghādiseso'ti.”
"Sacresso's tectonics, papatis, paphettis, abbheti, na ecapugalo."
“桑喀地谢思者，唯有僧团才能对其罪给与别住，给与退回原本，给与敬悦及令出罪，非多人，非一人[所能作]，因此称为‘桑喀地谢思’。”(V.1.237)
“Only the monks can leave their sins alone, give and return them to their originals, give them pleasure and cause them to sin, not many, not one person [can do it], and thus be called `Sankadesh'.” (V.1.327).
在《附随》中也说：
In the Annex, it is also stated:
“Saṅghādiseso'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ.
"I'm going to take a look at you. I'm going to take a look.
saṅghova deti parivāsaṃ, mūlāya paṭikassati;
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
mānattaṃ deti abbheti, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
I'm going to take care of it, and I'm going to take care of it."
“所谓‘桑喀地谢思’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `Sankadisha', please be honest:
唯有僧团才能给与别住、退回原本、
Only the monks can give away their homes, return them to their originals.
给与敬悦及令出罪，因此如是说。”(V.5.339)
Gives pleasure and makes sin, so say so.” (V.5.339)
违犯这一类学处者，虽然还不至于失去比库的资格，但为了恢复作为正常比库身份，他必须经历坦白至出罪的一系列程序——从最初的履行敬悦至最後的出罪，皆须由僧团来执行，而非个人或数人所能执行。如果比库在犯了其中任何一条学处之後，即应向一位或多位比库坦白他的罪行。如果犯戒者明知而隐瞒该罪行多少天，在忏罪前还必须依其隐瞒的天数来行别住(parivāsa)多少天。行别住之後，他应当通知一个至少有四位比库的僧团，向僧团请求实行为期六夜的敬悦。履行敬悦之後，犯戒比库应再向至少有二十位清净比库的僧团请求出罪(abbhana)。如果在不满二十位比库的僧团为这个比库出罪，即使才少一位，该比库也无法出罪。从履行别住到出罪期间，犯戒比库有94项僧权被中止。经出罪後，该比库才恢复正常比库的身份。
If the offender does not know how many days he has to hide the offence, he must stay in his place for how many days before he confesses it. After staying, he must inform at least four monks who confessed to the crime - from the first to the last of the sins - and ask the monks for six nights' pleasure. If he does so, he must confess to one or more of them. If he knows and conceals the crime, he must stay for how many days before he confesses to the crime, then he should notify at least four monks who did not commit the crime - from the first to the last of the sins - that he will ask the monks for six nights' pleasure. If he does so, then he should ask at least twenty monks who did so (abhana) to return to his position after the death. If he is not satisfied with the 20 monks who committed the crime, even one of them will not be able to do so.
共有十三条桑喀地谢思罪：
There are 13 cases of Sankadiya sin:
1. 故意出精
1. Deliberate insemination
2. 触摸女人
Touching women
3. 对女人说粗俗语
3. To speak vulgarly to women
4. 向女人赞叹以淫欲侍奉自己
4. Query to women to serve themselves with lust
5. 做媒
5. Media
6. 建无主孤邸
6. Hostage-free
7. 建大住所
7. Construction of large shelters
8. 以无根据巴拉基格诽谤
8. Misdefamation on the basis of unfounded Barakig
9. 取类似事情的巴拉基格诽谤
Barakig vilification of similar events
10. 分裂僧团
10. The separatist monks
11. 追随分裂僧团
11. Following the separatist monks
12. 不受劝告
12. Freedom from counsel
13. 污家不受驱摈
13. Non-exclusion of scavengers
对于此十三桑喀地谢思法，前面九条学处只需做一次即犯，後面四条学处则须经劝告三次才犯。
In the case of the thirteenth Sankadeshesian law, the first nine schools are required only once, while the next four schools are required to advise them three times.
三、不定
III. Non-certainty
不定 (aniyata)：是指尚未确定比库所违犯的是属于巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚三者之中的哪一种罪行的学处。
(i) Aniyata: it means that it has not yet been determined which of the crimes committed by Biku are those belonging to Barakig, Sankadheshes or Bagitia.
在《大分别》中解释说：
In the Major Division it is explained that:
“Aniyato'ti na niyato pārājikaṃ vā saṅghādiseso vā pācittiyaṃ vā.”
"Aniyato'ti na niyato pārājika .
“不定者，即不确定是巴拉基格、桑喀地谢思或巴吉帝亚。”(V.1.450)
“Uncertainty, i.e., Barakig, Sankadheshes or Bagitia.” (V.1.450)
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:
“Aniyato'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ;
"Aniyato'ti veta, I'm going to have to say hi to you."
aniyato na niyato, anekaṃsikataṃ padaṃ;
Aniyato na niyato, aneka sikata pada;
tiṇṇamaññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, niyato'ti pavuccati.”
I'm not going to leave you alone. I'm not going to leave you alone.
“所谓‘不定’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `uncertainty', please be honest:
不定即不确定，乃不确定三者中，
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know.
其中一处之语，称为‘不定’。”(V.5.339)
One of these words is called `uncertainty' (V.5.339).
若比库和女人单独坐在秘密隐蔽处或偏僻处时，被说话值得信赖的信徒看见，于是应根据比库自己承认，或根据该信徒的控告来惩治。如果行淫，则犯巴拉基格(第1)；若身体相接触或说粗俗语，则构成桑喀地谢思(第2或第3)；若只是和女人单独共坐，则犯巴吉帝亚(第44或45)。因罪行不确定，故名“不定”。
If Biku and a woman are seen by a trusted believer sitting alone in a secret shelter or in a remote place, then they shall be punished on their own admission or on the basis of the charge of that believer. If they commit adultery, they shall be guilty of Barakig (No. 1); if they touch each other or speak vulgar language, they shall constitute Sankardishes (No. 2 or 3); if they are alone with a woman, they shall be guilty of Bagitia (No. 44 or 45).
这一类学处只有两条：
There are only two such institutions:
1. 被控告和女人隐蔽处坐
1. The accused and the woman ' s place of refuge
2. 被控告和女人偏僻处坐
2. Indictments and women ' s isolation
四、尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚
IV. Nisadia Bagitia
尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚：巴利语nissaggiya pācittiya的音译。尼萨耆亚(nissaggiya)，意为应捨弃的；巴吉帝亚(pācittiya)，意为令心堕落。
Nisadia Bagitia: a translation of the Pāḷi language nissaggiya pācittiya. Nissagiya, which is supposed to be abandoned, and pācittiya, which is meant to be corrupt.
在《附随》中说：
In the Annex, it is stated:
“Nissaggiyan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ;
"Nissaggiyan's body, my body, my heart, my heart, my heart."
saṅghamajjhe gaṇamajjhe, ekasseva ca ekato;
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
nissajjitvāna deseti, tenetaṃ iti vuccati.”
I don't know what to do with it.
“所谓‘尼萨耆亚’者，请听如实说：
“As for the so-called `Nisamia', please be honest:
在僧团中间、众人中间或只在一人前，
In the midst of the monks, among the people, or in front of only one man,

这一类学处主要是关于比库行止威仪的规定。这一类学处并不象其它“止持”学处一样，采用说出罪名的方式，即“若比库……者，犯恶作”，而是在学处之後加上“应当学”(sikkhā karaṇīya)，这显示了此类学处乃属于“作持”的范畴，即“应当如此作”之义。比库只有以不恭敬的态度违犯这一类学处，才犯恶作罪。
This type of school is mainly about Byku's rules. It does not use the same means of culpability as other “stop” schools, i.e., “Jobycu ..., who commits an evil”, but instead adds the words “sikkhā kara beya” after the School, which shows that such schools fall within the category of “governance”, i.e. “should do so.” Byku only commits a crime if he violates this type of school with disrespect.

75. 不在水中大小便或吐唾液
75. Not excrement or spit in water.
八、七止争法
Eight, seven battles.
七止争法(satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā)是用来止息僧团争事的七种方法：
The seven-year dispute law (satta adhikara asamathā dhammā) is the seven methods used to stop the monks' dispute:
1. 现前调伏
1. Turning forward
2. 忆念调伏
2. Memories
3. 不痴调伏
3. Non-aggression
4. 自认
4. Self-identification
5. 依多数
5. By majority
6. 对那恶劣者
To the evil one.
7. 以草覆盖
7. Grass cover

第六节 学处与罪

如果比库违犯了此227条学处，将依不同的违犯程度而构成七种罪。此七种罪从重至轻依次为：
If Biku violates this section of Article 227, he will be guilty of seven offences, depending on the degree of violation.
1. 巴拉基格(pārājika)；
1. Barakig (pārājika);
2. 桑喀地谢思(saṅghādisesa)；
2. Sankadisha (saghādisesa);
3. 土喇吒亚(thullaccaya, 粗罪)；
3. thullaccaya, gross crime;
4. 巴吉帝亚(pācittiya)；
4. Bagitia (pācittiya);
5. 应悔过(pāṭidesanīya)；
5. Repent (pédidesanbeya);
6. 恶作(dukkaṭa)，即不好的行为；
6. Misdemeanour (dukka a), i.e. bad behaviour;
7. 恶说(dubbhāsita, 不好的言语) 。
7. Naughty (dubbhāsita, bad words).
当知学处(sikkhāpada)与罪(āpatti)是有所不同的。“学处”相当于戒条，皆为佛陀所制定，是每一位弟子都应当持守的。“罪”则是由于持戒者有意或无意违犯了学处而构成的过错。
The Sikkhāpada is different from the crime (āpatti). “Study” is the same as the dogma, set by Buddha, and should be observed by every student.
例如巴拉基格学处的第二条为“不与取”，假如比库企图偷取他人的贵重物品，碰触到即犯恶作，移动犯土喇吒亚，物品离开原处即犯巴拉基格。
For example, the second article of the Barakig School is “incompetence” and, if Biku tries to steal valuables from others, to touch them, to carry them out, to move them out of their place of origin, and to do so, to do so.
第三条为“故意杀人”，假如比库企图杀人，在为杀人做准备工作时犯恶作，当受害者感到痛苦时犯土喇吒亚，若受害者因此死亡即犯巴拉基格。
Article 3 refers to “intentional killing” if Biku attempted to kill, committed a heinous act in preparation for the murder, committed a crime in the course of suffering to the victim, and committed a crime in the event of the death of the victim, Barakig.
又如巴吉帝亚第四十条学处“吃未授与的食物”，假如比库为了吃未经授与的食物而拿取者，犯恶作；每吞咽一口，皆犯一巴吉帝亚。
The same is true of article 40 of the Bajitia School, which “eats unlicensed food” if Biku takes it for unlicensed food, commits an evil act; and for every swallow, a Bagitia is committed.
因此，对于同一条学处，将会根据不同程度的违犯而构成轻重不同的罪过。对于四条巴拉基格学处，只有在具足所有违犯条件的情况下才构成巴拉基格罪，而且最高的罪行即是巴拉基格；若缺少一两项条件，则可能犯较轻的罪，甚至不犯。对于桑喀地谢思罪、尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚罪、巴吉帝亚罪、应悔过罪等也依此类推。不过，对于应学法，故意违犯任何一条学处皆只构成恶作罪。
Thus, the same section would constitute a different offence depending on the degree of violation. For the four Barakigs, the crime would only be committed if all the conditions for violation were met, and the highest offence would be Barakig; if one or two conditions were lacking, the less serious offence would be committed, if not the less serious one. The same would apply to the Sankatiya crimes, Nisapya Bagitia, Bagitia, Repentation.
对于比库违犯跋葛瓦所制定的学处，依其罪过的种类又可分为以下几种：
In the case of Biku, the establishments set up by Gwa in violation of the law can be divided into the following categories according to the type of offence committed:
一、重罪与轻罪
I. SETTLEMENTS AND DISAPPEARANCES
1.重罪(garukāpatti)有两种，即：
There are two types of felonies (garukāpatti), namely:
⑴巴拉基格：不可忏之罪(atekicchā)；
(1) Barakig: Independable (atekicchā);
⑵桑喀地谢思：可忏之罪(satekicchā)，违犯此罪者先须坦白其罪，并经僧团的一系列处分後才能恢复清净。
(2) Sankadesh: a confessionable crime (satekicchā), the perpetrator of which must confess his or her guilt before he or she can recover his or her innocence after a series of punishments by the monks.
2.轻罪(lahukāpatti)有五种，属于可忏之罪，即：
2. There are five types of misdemeanour (lahukāpatti) which are punishable by confession, namely:
⑴土喇吒亚；
(i) Tulanya;
⑵巴吉帝亚；
(2) Bagitia;
⑶应悔过；
(3) Repent;
⑷恶作；
(iv) Misdemeanours;
⑸恶说。
(5) Naughty.
违犯这五种轻罪的比库，只需向另一位比库坦白其罪，然後进行忏悔即可恢复清净。
If the bhikkhu had violated the five misdemeanours, he would have to confess his guilt to another bhikkhu and then repent.
二、有心罪与无心罪
II. CRIMINAL AND INCIDENTAL CRIME
1.有心罪(sacittaka)：通过故意（有心）违犯学处才构成的罪过。有些学处必须通过故意违犯才构成罪过，若非故意则不犯。如故意杀人犯巴拉基格，故意杀害生命犯巴吉帝亚等。
1. Sacitttaka: A crime committed with intent (intentional) in violation of the school system. Some schools must commit an offence by wilful violation or, if they fail to do so, do not commit such an offence.
2.无心罪(acittaka)：无意违犯之罪。有些学处即使无意违犯，只要符合违犯的条件也会构成罪。如施主将金钱装进袋中供养比库，比库误认为是如法物品而接受，也构成违犯尼萨耆亚巴吉帝亚。
2. Unintentional (acittaka): Unintentional offences. Some schools, even if they do not intend to violate them, will be guilty if they meet the conditions for violation. If the money is placed in a bag to provide for the piècean, it will also constitute a violation of Nisadia Bagitia if it is erroneously accepted as an item of law.
三、由想得脱与非由想得脱
iii. I can't help but think.
1.由想得脱之罪(saññāvimokkhā)：由于没有违犯学处之想而得以逃脱的罪过。这种罪是指无意违犯有心罪而言。
1. The crime of escape (sañāvimokkhā): a crime that has been escaped without violating the wishes of the School. This crime is defined as an offence of intent.
2.非由想得脱之罪(nosaññāvimokkhā)：不管有没有违犯学处之想，只要符合违犯的条件都不能逃脱的罪过。这种罪过是指故意违犯有心罪和违犯无心罪而言。
2. Nosañāvimokkhā: a crime that cannot be escaped, regardless of whether or not it is in violation of the educational system, provided that the conditions for the violation are met. Such a crime means a deliberate offence and a misdemeanour.
四、世间罪与制定罪
IV. UNIVERSAL CRIME AND CRIMINAL CRIME
1.世间罪(lokavajja)：生起不善心故意违犯的行为，或者社会上普遍认为是不合乎道德的行为。有些行为不仅对比库、比库尼而言是不能做的，即使对世俗普通人来说也是不道德的行为。如故意杀人、不与取、说虚妄语等。
1. The crime of the world (lokavajja): Some acts are not only unconscionable, but also immoral, even for secular ordinary people. They are intentional killings, incompetences, falsehoods, etc.
2.制定罪(paṇṇattivajja)：由跋葛瓦所制定、只是针对比库、比库尼违犯才构成的罪过。有些学处只是规定比库、比库尼才不能违越，但是世俗普通人造作并不会构成罪过。如接受金钱、从事买卖、挖掘土地等。
2. Prosecuting (pa attivajja): A crime committed by the Gowa and committed only against bhikkhu and Bikuni. Some schools provide for Biku and Bikuni only, but ordinary man-made acts of secularism do not constitute a crime, such as accepting money, trading and excavating land.
五、身业、语业与身语业
V. PROFESSIONAL, LANGUAGE AND LANGUAGE
1.身业罪(kāyakamma)：通过身体行为违犯的罪过。如从事淫欲法、故意出精、触摸女人等。
1. The offence of profligacy (kāyakama): an offence committed by means of a physical act, such as the practice of lewdness, the deliberate depredation, the touching of a woman.
2.语业罪(vacīkamma)：通过语言违犯的罪过。如和未达上者同句诵法、对女人说法过限等。
2. Language offences (vacbekamma): offences committed through language.
3.身业和语业罪(kāyakammaṃ vacīkammañca)：能通过身体行为和语言两者违犯的罪过。如不与取、故意杀人、说虚妄的上人法等。
3. The crime of proficient and speech (kāyakama vacbekammañca): offences that can be violated by both physical conduct and language, such as lack of connection, wilful homicide, false pretences, etc.
须知并没有纯粹由意门（心念）构成的犯戒。
There is no simple (intentional) punishment.

第七节 伍波思特的起源

佛教僧团有每隔半个月念诵《巴帝摩卡》戒经的传统。因此，僧团诵戒称为“伍波思特”。
The Buddhist monks have a tradition of reading the Book of Batiamoka every half month. Thus, the monks are called “Wubost”.
伍波思特，巴利语uposatha的音译。该词源于梵语upavasatha。若依音义法来解释，upavasatha 由 upa(近，随) + vas(住) + atha组成，直译为“近住”，即在特定的日子里持斋戒的意思。
Woodburn, uposatha. The word is derived from the Sanskrit languageupavasatha. If interpreted in a symphony way,upavasatha consists of upa (near, with) + vas (near) + atha, which is translated directly into "near living" meaning fasting on a given day.
义註中如此解释“伍波思特”：
This is the explanation in the note for Woodbird:
“‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。近住是以持戒或禁食作为具足而住之意。在此举出一些意思：‘来，贤友咖比那，我们去伍波思特吧’等为诵巴帝摩卡的伍波思特。‘维萨卡，如此以八支具足而住于伍波思特’(增5.43)等为戒。‘二月确实常清净，伍波思特常清净’(M.1. 79)等为持戒。‘龙王名叫伍波思特’(D.2.246)等是名称。‘诸比库，不得在伍波思特当天从有比库的住处[前往无比库的住处]’(V.3.181)等为应近住之日；这才是这里的意思。由于它可分为八日、十四日、十五日三种，所以排除了其馀两种而说在十五日。由此而说:‘于此日近住’为伍波思特。”(D.A.1.150; M.A.3.85)
“Being close on this day is Woopostste.” Nearness is meant to be a good watch or a fasting. Here are some of the meanings: `Come, friend Quadina, let's go to Wuboste to recite Batimoca. `Visaca, so long as eight are sufficient to live in Wooboste' (up 5.43), etc. `It is true that in February it is always clean, Woodhouse is clean' (M.1.79), etc. `Loon's name is `D.2.246', and `The Queen's name is `D. 2.246, and `The Queen Queen Quay Quay, may not live near Quay' on that day from Quil [to the non-Bicca residence]' (V.3.181), etc. `This is what it means. It can be divided into eight days, fourteen days and fifteen days, so it is said: `D.246. `D. 150.A.85.
综合上述义註的解释，伍波思特有三种意思：
In combination with the above-mentioned interpretation, Woodstone has three meanings:
1. 一个月当中特定的日期——斋戒日
Specific dates in one month — Ramadan Day
古印度的历法属于太阴历，一年分十二个月，月份按月亮绕地球运转的周期推算。推算方法是从每个月圆日的第二天明相出现(aruṇuggamana,黎明)时开始算起，到下一个月圆日的第二天明相出现为至结束，约三十天（小月为二十九天）的时间为一个月。如此，每个月又可分为两个半月：从月圆日翌日开始到月黑日为“黑月”，从月黑日翌日开始到月圆日为“白月”。其中，月黑日和月圆日两天皆称为“十五日”(paṇṇarasika)。若遇小月，月黑日也可以在十四日。于是，在每半个月中，第八日、第十四和第十五日皆称为“伍波思特日”或“斋戒日”(uposatha-divasa)。斋戒日的日期约相当于中国农历的初八、十四、十五、二十三、廿九和三十日。
The ancient Indian calendar is a lunar calendar of 12 months a year, calculated by the cycle of the moon around the Earth. The method of calculation begins on the day after each full month (aru uggmana, dawn) and ends on the day after the next full month, and ends on the day after the next full month (about 30 days (29 days in small months). Thus, each month can be divided into two and a half months: from the day after the first day of the month to the day of the month “Black Moon”, from the day after the day of the month to the day of the moon until the day of the full moon. Of these, the dates for the day of the fasting are known as “Fifteen days” (pa arasika). In the event of a small month, the month can also end in 14 days.
2. 在家居士所持守的学处之一 ——八戒
One of the schools held by the homeowners - the Eight Rings
自从佛陀跋葛瓦在世时开始，在家居士就有于每个月的斋日来到塔寺，亲近僧团，听闻佛法，受持八戒的传统。由于八戒多数是在“伍波思特日”受持的，所以称为“具足八支(条)的伍波思特戒法”(aṭṭhaṅga samannāgata uposatha-sīla dhamma)。
Since the time of the life of the Buddha's Guevah, family members have come to the Temple on Ramadan every month, close to the monks, to hear the Buddha's law and to be held in a tradition of eight. As most of the VIIIs are held on Woodbash Day, they are called the “Wordbeth Revival Act” (a ha ga samannāgata uposa-sbela dhamma).
3. 僧团举行的甘马之一 ——诵戒
One of the Ganmars held by the monasteries — a recitation
佛陀跋葛瓦规定：比库僧应在每个月的月圆日和月黑日两天举行伍波思特。在这一天，共住同一界内的所有比库僧应齐集界场，举行伍波思特甘马(uposathakamma)，念诵戒经《比库巴帝摩卡》(pātimokkhuddesa)。
The Buddha district Gwa stipulates that the Biku Monks shall meet in Wuboste two days each month at the full moon and on the dark of the moon. On that day, all Biku Monks shall meet in the same border, where uposathakamma will be held and the Bikumokkhuddesa will be recited.
由于“伍波思特”含有上述多种意思，以“多义不翻”故，一般情况多采用音译，在特定意义时则采用意译。
Because of the many meanings described above, “Wubost” is used more generally than in the case of “multiple meanings” or, in the case of particular meanings, in the case of translation.
伍波思特源于古印度吠陀以来的祭法。佛陀在世时，其他外道团体有于每半个月的八日、十四日、十五日举行集会的习惯。佛陀跋葛瓦接受马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王(Rājā māgadha seniya Bimbisāra)的建议，规定比库僧团应于斋日集会，向信徒们说法，後来又规定于每半月的十五日或十四日齐集诵《巴帝摩卡》。佛教僧团于每半月举行伍波思特诵戒的制度由此而来。
Woodburn comes from the rituals of ancient Indian Vedas. Buddha's other foreign-world groups are accustomed to meeting every half month on 8th, 14th, and 15th. Buddha's Guwa accepted the advice of Rājāmāgadha seniya Bimbisāra of the State of Margot, which stipulates that the bhikkhu monks should meet on Ramadan and speak to the faithful, and then provide for a reading of the Batiamaka every half month on 15th or 14th days. The Buddhist monks meet every half month with a system of Wuboth readings.
在《律藏·诵戒篇》中说：
In The Book of the Book of the Book:
“当时，佛陀跋葛瓦住在王舍城鹫峰山。那个时候，外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们前往该处闻法。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。
“At that time, the Buddha's Gowa lived in Wang Shek Mountain. At that time, the monks of the outer lanes met on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month, and people went to hear it. They were loved, confident, and followers of the outside world.
当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得了信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
At the time, King Xenia Binbisler of Magogte was alone in the middle of nowhere, thinking: "Now, the stories of the excursors meeting on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month, and people go there to hear it. They get love and confidence from the excursors, and they get believers from the excursors. Then they can meet on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month.
于是，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王来到跋葛瓦之处。来到之後，顶礼跋葛瓦，坐在一边。坐在一边的马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王对跋葛瓦这样说：
So King Xenia Binbisal of Magogte came to the part of Gwa. Then he came to the top of Gwa, sitting side by side. King Xenia Binbisal of Magogte, sitting side by side, said to Gwa:
‘尊者，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：现在外道游方僧们在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会说法，人们为闻法前往该处。他们对外道游方僧获得喜爱、获得信心，外道游方僧们获得信徒。就让诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。萨度！尊者，诸聖尊们也可在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’
‘So, I am alone in the middle of the month, and I think so: now the monks of the outside world meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month, and the people travel there in their ears. They are loved, confident, and the monks of the outside world receive their followers. Let the saints also meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month. And the lords of the Shadu, may meet in the 14th, 15th and 8th days of the month.’
于是，跋葛瓦向马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励、令喜悦。当时，马葛特国谢尼亚·宾比萨勒王受跋葛瓦以法之论开示、劝导、鼓励而喜悦，从座而起，顶礼跋葛瓦，右绕之後离开。
As a result, Guevah inspired, persuaded, encouraged, and pleased King Xenia Binbissal of Magogte by the concept of the law. At that time, King Xenia Binbissal of Magogte was inspired, persuaded, encouraged and pleased by the idea of the law of the District, from the seat, from the top, from the top to the right, and then to the right.
于是，跋葛瓦于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
As a result of this opportunity, Biku was told that:
‘诸比库，我允许在半月的十四日、十五日及八日集会。’”(V.3.132)
`The Zhubyku, I allow the meeting to take place on the 14th, 15th and 8th of the month.' (V.3.132)
“当时，跋葛瓦在僻静地独处，心生如此想法:‘现在我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。’
“At that time, Gwa was alone in a quiet place, and thought so: `Now, the place I have set up for Bikus, should allow them to recite the Batiamocca, which they will use as a Woo-Bothtganma.'
于是，跋葛瓦在傍晚时分禅坐起来後，于此因缘、于此机会说法而告诉比库们说：
As a result, after Gwa had sat down at nightfall, he told Bikus, by reason of this opportunity,:
‘诸比库，于此，我在僻静地独处，心生如此想法：‘我为比库们所制定的学处，应允许他们诵该巴帝摩卡，他们将以此为伍波思特甘马。诸比库，我允许诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.133)
‘And here, I am alone in the shadows, and I am thinking, ‘The place I have set for Bikus should allow them to recite the Batiamocca, which they will use as Woopostegama.’ ‘Zhubicou, I allow the Batiamocca.’” (V.3.133)
“那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许伍波思特日诵巴帝摩卡，在半个月中诵了三次巴帝摩卡——在半月的十四日、十五日及八日。跋葛瓦因此宣告：
“At that time, Bikus allowed the Whoboste Day to recite Batiamocca, three times in six months — on the 14th, 15th, and 8th of the month. And so Gowa declared:
‘诸比库，不应半个月诵三次巴帝摩卡。若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许每半个月一次——在十四日或十五日——诵巴帝摩卡。’”(V.3.136)
'The Chumpicos should not recite Badimoca three times a month.' If the Recitation does evil, We allow it to be recited every half month - on 14 or 15 days.' (V.3.136).

第八节 诵巴帝摩卡的时间和地点

既然佛陀跋葛瓦规定比库们于每半个月诵一次巴帝摩卡，即在第十四日或第十五日。具体在十四或十五日，则应视历法而定。
If the Buddha region Gwa requires bhikkhu to recite the Batiamocca every half month, i.e. on the fourteenth or fifteenth day.
在律註中说：
It says:
“Cātuddase vā pannarase vā'ti ekassa utuno tatiye ca sattame ca pakkhe dvikkhattuṃ cātuddase, avasese chakkhattuṃ pannarase.”
"I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to do this, but I'm not going to do it."
“在十四日或十五日是指在一个季节中的第三个和第七个半月两次[诵戒]在十四日，其馀六次在十五日。”(V.A.3.136)
“On 14 or 15 days means the third and seventh half-month [recitation] in one season and the sixth in 15 days on 14 days.” (V.A.3.136)
根据古印度的历法，一年分为3个季节：热季(gimhāna)、雨季(vassāna)和凉季(hemanta)，每个季节有4个月，共12个月。如此，一个季节有8个诵戒日，每月有2个，即黑月的十五日（月黑日）和白月的十五日（月圆日）。由于每个季节皆由黑月开始，因此逢单数的诵戒日为月黑日，逢双数的诵戒日为月圆日。在每个季节中，第1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8个半月有15天(paṇṇarasa)，而第3和第7个半月只有14天(catuddasa)。也即是说：在每个季节的第3个和第7个月黑日为“十四日”，其馀的皆为“十五日”。
According to the ancient Indian calendar, each year is divided into three seasons: the hot season (gimhāna), the rainy season (vassāna) and the cool season (hemanta), each of which is four months and a total of 12 months. Thus, there are eight days for each season, two days for each month, 15 days for the black month (on the black of the month) and 15 days for the white month (on the round of the moon).
所以，僧团安排诵巴帝摩卡的日期，在每个季节的第三次和第七次诵戒在“十四日”，其馀的六次都在“十五日”。这是僧团举行诵戒的日期。
Thus, the monks set the dates for the reading of Batiamoka, the third and seventh readings of each season in “fourteen days” and the sixth readings in “thirteen days”. This is the date on which the monks hold the readings.
至于在诵戒日的什么时候举行伍波思特，则可由各个僧团自行决定。现在许多僧团会选择在下午或傍晚举行。
It is up to the monasteries to decide when to hold Woodburn on the Day of Recitation. Many monks now choose to hold it in the afternoon or evening.
由于伍波思特甘马是僧团中比较重要的集会，所以《律藏》中对诵戒的场所有详细的规定：
Since Woodboshtganma is a more important gathering in the monks, all the details of the recitation field in the Collection are as follows:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘跋葛瓦制定：依和合而为一住处。那怎样才是一住处呢？’此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]‘诸比库，我允许共结界。诸比库，应如此共结：首先应宣告[界]相——山相、石相、林相、树相、道路相、蚁垤相、河相、水相。”(V.3.138)
“At the time, Bikus thought, `The `Zone Gwa was set up as a residence.' What would be a place of residence?' The Zone Gwa was reported, [The Zone Gwa said] `The Zhu Gwa, I allow the Zhugwa to be bound together. `The Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu, Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Zhu Z
也即是说：住在同一区域的所有比库僧众必须集合在一起举行伍波思特甘马。凡举行甘马的地方，必须经由僧团共同认定范围，称为“结界”(sīmā sammuti)。在结界前，先须设立界相(sīmā nimitta)，即范围的标记。律中允许八种界相：以山为界相、以石为界相、以林为界相、以树为界相、以道路为界相、以蚁垤为界相、以河流为界相和以水为界相。现在的做法多数是以石为界相。
That is to say, all Biku monks who live in the same area must gather together to hold Woodbashtgama. Where Ganma is held, it must be determined by the monks, known as the "Sbelmā sammuti." Before the border is closed, the boundary must be marked by a boundary (sbelmā nimitta), which is the range. The law permits eight boundaries: mountain, stone, forest, tree, road, ant, river and water. Most of the ways now are stone.
在律註《疑惑度脱》中提到，界可以分为“已结之界”(baddhasīmā)和“未结之界”(abaddhasīmā)两类。其中，已结之界又可分为划定界、共住界和不离衣界三种；未结之界又可分为村界、七阿邦答勒界和泼水界三种。
In the commentary, "Suspension of Disquiet", it is mentioned that the boundary can be divided into "baddhasbemā" and "baddhasbemā" (Baddhasbemā). In addition, the boundary can be divided into "delineation" and "cohabitation" and "no separation"; the boundary can be divided into "village", "seven Abantal" and "water pouring."
在此将通过“以石为界相”来简单地说明结界的程序：先划定“界”范围。根据律制，界的范围最大不得超过三由旬，最小必须能够容纳二十一位比库坐下。划定界的范围後，再找来十六块大小相当的石块（范围较小者，八块也可以），分别放置于界的东南西北方和四个角落，每处各放两块，并把里面的那块作为“石相”(pāsāṇanimitta)。
The process of bordering is briefly described here by “stone-to-stone”: first, the “boundary” is delimited. According to the law, the boundary is not to be more than three quarters long, but must at least be able to accommodate twenty-one bicoons. When the boundary is delimited, 16 more stones (smaller, eight can be) of a similar size will be found, located in the north-west south-west and four corners of the boundary, with two blocks each, and the one inside as a “boul phase” (pās animitta).
举行结界甘马前，先安排八位比库或未达上者分别站在界外的石相後边，然後再安排一位比库依次走到每个石相前，问道：“在东方是什么[界]相？”“石，尊者！”“这石是[界]相。”“是的，尊者！”……问完八方的界相後，再走到东方重复问一次，如是使所有界相皆能成为一连结。
Before holding the Gama of the borderline, arrange for eight pictories or unreached to stand behind each other, and then arrange for one by Biku to go to each of the rocks, and ask, “What is the [boundary] in the East?” “The Stone, the Lord!” “The Stone is the [boundary] in the East.” “Yes, the Lord!” After having asked the eight sides of the border, come to the East again and ask again, if all of them are bound together.
问完界相後，所有比库齐集于伸手所及的范围内，宣讲甘马文，共同认定此界为“共住、同一伍波思特界”(samānasaṃvāsa ekuposatha sīmā)。认定了“共住界”之後，再认定“不离衣界”(avippavāsa sīmā)。于是，在这个被划定的范围内所结之界，称为“划定界”(khaṇḍasīmā)。
After the interview, all Bikuchi gathered within the reach of his hand to speak of the Ganmarin community, which he identified as the “co-inhabited, and the same Wubosa” (samānasa vāsa ekuposatha sbemā). After identifying the “co-inhabited border”, he identified the “inhabited border” (avippavāsa sbemā).
佛陀又规定，如果在一个地方原先曾经如法地结过界，此後在该处所结之界皆为无效。为此，佛陀允许先解除原来所结之界(sīmāsamūhanana)，然後再结新界。如果想在一个新的地方结界，但又不清楚古代是否曾经结过界，为了使日後的甘马皆成为有效，为了保险起见，在结新界之前通常会先解除旧界。由于解界的甘马颇为复杂，于此不作详论。
Buddha has also ruled that if a border had previously been established in a place, then it would not be valid. To that end, Buddha has allowed the original boundary to be removed and then the new border to be closed. If it is to be closed in a new place, it is not clear whether the ancients did, and in order to make the day-to-day Mamas effective, it will normally be dissolved before the new border is closed, for insurance reasons.
等结界甘马圆满之後，可把石相分别埋于界场的四方四隅，每处埋两块，里面的石块为界相，其外再预留出中间地带，称为“界隔”(sīmantarika)，以避免和其它的“界”相重叠。埋石相时，石块的上半部可以露出地面，形成明显的标记，使人们能清楚地辨认出界相。
When the boundary is filled with mares, the rocks can be buried in four squares, each of which is two blocks, each of which is a boundary, and the middle is set aside, called the Sbermantarika, to avoid overlap with the other “frontiers.” When the rocks are buried, the first half of the rock can be exposed to the ground and form a clear mark that allows for a clear identification of the boundary.
在《律藏》中又提到“未结之界”的三种情况：
There are three more cases of “unfinished boundaries” mentioned in the Collection:
“诸比库，在无结界或未设置处，若依止村庄或城镇而住，则以该村庄为村界，以城镇为镇界，为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
“The village shall be used as the boundary of the village, and the town shall be the boundary of the town and the co-occupancy of the village and of the Wuboth [frontier], if the village or town is located on the unsolved or unincorporated border.
诸比库，如果在非村的林野，则周围以七个阿邦答勒为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。
In the non-village woodfields, the Nhubiku are surrounded by seven Abontals, co-located with the same Wubost [boundary].
诸比库，一切河非界，一切海非界，一切自然湖非界。诸比库，若在河、海或自然湖中，则以中等[身材的]男子向周围泼水处为该处的共住、同一伍波思特[界]。”(V.3.147)
Dhubyku, all rivers, all seas, all lakes, all natural lakes, and in rivers, seas, or natural lakes, medium-sized [heavy] men pour water around them as co-habitants and the same Wuboste [boundary].” (V.3.147).
也即是说，如果比库去到边远的地方（例如欧洲、美洲）或没有界场的地方，可以当地政府设置的最小行政区域的范围作为村界(gāmasīmā)或镇界(nigamasīmā)。到了诵戒日，只要在该区域内的所有比库皆齐集并超过四位，则可举行诵戒。
This means that, if bhikkhu goes to a remote location (e.g. Europe, America) or to a place where there are no boundaries, the smallest administrative area set up by the local government can be the village (gāmasbemā) or the town (nigamasbemā).
在森林、郊野等处，则以人站在中央算起，四周各以七个阿邦德勒(sattabbhantarā)的范围为界，称为“七阿邦德勒界”(sattabbhantarasīmā)。这里，一个阿邦德勒等于28肘、56拃手的长度。
In forests, suburbs, etc., people stand in the center, each of which is defined by the seven sattabbhantarās, called the “sattabbhandaras bemā”. Here, one Abondler is equal to 28 elbows, and 56 hand lengths.
如果是在河流、海洋或天然湖泊中央，则以一个中等身材的男子向四周尽力泼水，水所洒落的范围称为“泼水界”(udakukkhepasīmā)。
In the middle of a river, ocean or natural lake, water is poured around the surrounding area by a medium-sized man, the extent of which is referred to as the udakukkhepasbemā.
比库僧团可在这三种已结之界和三种未结之界内举行伍波思特甘马，诵巴帝摩卡。
The Biku Monks can hold Wuboste Ganma in these three closed and three unsolved bounds to recite Batiamoka.

第九节 诵巴帝摩卡的基本程序

念诵巴帝摩卡可以分为略诵和广诵两种。除非是在发生危难的时候可以略诵，在正常情况下僧团皆须广诵。
The recitation of Batiamoka can be divided into a short reading and a broad reading. Except in times of distress, the monks must read it out in normal circumstances.
在《律藏》中说：
In the book, it says:
“当时，比库们这样想：‘有多少种诵巴帝摩卡?’
"And at that time, more than Cocos thought, "How many of them recited Badimoca?"
此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
This is reported to Gowa.
‘诸比库，有五种诵巴帝摩卡：
"The Zhubykus, five of the different scriptures of Batiamoca:
诵完序後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第一种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after that it shall be declared as hearing. This is the first of the recitations of Badi Mocca.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第二种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after the reading of the four barakigs, it shall be declared that which is heard; this is the second reading of Batiamuka.
诵完序、诵完四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第三种诵巴帝摩卡。
And after the prayer, and after the recitation of the Four Barakig, and the Thirteen Monks, declare what they have heard; and this is the third recitation of Batiamoka.
诵完序、诵四巴拉基格、诵完十三僧始终、诵完二不定後，可宣告其馀的已听闻；这是第四种诵巴帝摩卡。
After the precitation, after the recitation of the four Barakigs, and after the reading of the thirteen monks, after the reading of the thirteen monks, and after the reading of the undeclared, they shall be able to declare what they have heard, and this is the fourth recitation of the Badi Mocca.
第五为广诵。
Fifthly, it's widely read.
诸比库，有这五种诵巴帝摩卡。’
Zhubyku, there's five of these quotes from Batiamoka.'
那个时候，比库们以跋葛瓦允许略诵巴帝摩卡，在一切时皆略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, Bikus allowed Batiamuka to be recited to the district of Gwa, and at all times to be recited to Batiamuka.
‘诸比库，不得略诵巴帝摩卡！若略诵者，犯恶作。’
‘Piku, not to recite Batiamuka! If you recite, do evil.’
那个时候，高沙喇国的一个住处在伍波思特当天发生了蛮族动乱，比库们不能广诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, a house in the Gosa Lama was in the middle of the day of a riot of barbarians in Wooposte, and Bikus were unable to read more about Batiamoka.
‘诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。’
"Phicoku, I will allow a little recitation of Batiamoka in times of distress."
那个时候，六众比库在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。此事报告跋葛瓦，[跋葛瓦说:]
At that time, the six bicoons recited Badimoca in the absence of distress.
‘诸比库，不得在无危难时略诵巴帝摩卡！若诵者，犯恶作。诸比库，我允许在有危难时略诵巴帝摩卡。在此的危难是：王难、贼难、火灾、水灾、人难、非人难、猛兽难、蛇难、命难和梵行难。诸比库，我允许在像这些危难[发生]时略诵巴帝摩卡，无危难时则广诵。’”(V.3.150)
‘The Pickus shall not recite Badimuka in the absence of distress! If the reciter does evil, I will allow the recitation of Badimuka in the event of distress. Here are the distresses: kings, thieves, fire, floods, humans, inhumans, beasts, snakes, fates, and vandals.’ ‘Pikus, I will allow the recitation of Badimuka in the event of [the occurrence of] these distresses, and when there is no distress, I will read it widely.’” (V.3.150)
到了诵戒日，僧团通常会出通知，提醒僧众们今天是诵戒日，并写明诵戒的时间和地点。
On the day of the recitation, the monks usually give notice to remind the monks that today is the day of the recitation and to state the time and place of the recitation.
诵巴帝摩卡一般可分为四个程序：
The reading of Batiamoka is usually divided into four procedures:
1.准备工作
Preparatory work
2.宣告事前工作等
2. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
3.正诵
3. Recitation
4.回向
4. Retroactivity
一、准备工作
I. Preparatory work
准备工作又可分为事前任务和事前工作两种。
The preparatory work can be divided into ex ante tasks and ex ante work.
1.事前任务包括打扫卫生、点灯、准备饮用水和洗用水、铺设座位四项。这四项工作必须在僧团齐集界场之前由下座比库或沙马内勒等完成。
1. The pre-mission tasks include cleaning, lighting, preparation of potable water and washing of water, and the laying of four seats. The four tasks must be performed by the next seat, the Piku or Shamanel, before the Monk meets the boundary.
2.事前工作包括带来有事比库的意欲（chanda，请假）和清净(pārisuddhi)、计算季节和诵戒的次数、计算参加诵戒比库的人数、教诲比库尼等四项。
Prior work consists of bringing about a situation involving the desire (chanda, leave) and clean (pārisuddhi), the calculation of seasons and the number of readings, the calculation of the number of participants in the reading of the book, and the teaching of Bikuni.
由于跋葛瓦规定犯戒的比库不能参加诵戒，所以，知道自己犯戒的比库在诵戒之前应该到另外一位比库面前坦白并忏悔自己所犯之罪。如果该比库所犯的都是轻罪，则在忏罪之後即回复清净。如果合格的比库达到四位或以上，则可开始举行伍波思特。
Since bhikkhu, who is charged with his or her crime, is not allowed to take part in the recitation, he or she should come to another bhikkhu to confess and confess to his or her crime before he or she reads it. If he or she is guilty of a misdemeanour, he or she will be released after the confession.
僧团在举行所有甘马时，处在同一界内的比库皆须齐集一处，并且不得分离于手臂之距离。也即是说，所有参加甘马的比库皆应挨近在一起共坐，两位比库之间的距离不能超过伸手所及的距离。
The monks must be gathered together in the Bico within the same boundary and must not be separated from their arms. That is to say, all the Bicos who participate in the Kamma should sit together, and the distance between the two Bicos must not exceed the distance reached by the hand.
同时，在此比库聚中，除了比库之外，其他的所有人，包括比库尼、沙马内勒、在家人等皆不得内进，应远离到至少一个伸手所及的距离之外。
At the same time, in this gathering, all but Biku, including Bikuni, Shamanele, family members, etc., are not allowed inside and should be kept away from at least one reach.
二、宣告事前工作等
II. Declaration of pre-service, etc.
在开始诵巴帝摩卡之前，僧团长老会选两位比库作为问律者和答律者，以问答的方式告知僧团伍波思特的各项准备工作做得如何、僧团是否达到诵戒的条件等。 宣告通常使用巴利语，但有些派别只由一位比库诵完宣告的内容，甚至是用当地的语言来宣告（如缅甸的善法派）。
Before beginning the reading of Pātimokkha, the Monk Chief will choose two Bikus as law-and-answerers to inform the monks in question and answer questions about the manner in which Woodbowst's preparations were carried out, whether the monks met the terms of the recitation, etc. The proclamations are usually in the Pāḷi language, but some of the factions have only one Biku to finish the announcement, even in the local language (e.g. Myanmar's good law sect).
三、正诵
III. RELEVANT
当一切准备就绪後，僧团中的长老会指派一位比库诵巴帝摩卡（通常会事先通知）。于是，这位比库以巴利语背诵《比库巴帝摩卡》。
When everything was ready, the Presbyterian Church of the Monarchs appointed a Biku-Badimoca (usually with prior notice). The Biku-Pāḷi recited Biku-Pāḷi.
完整地背诵巴帝摩卡一般需要35-50分钟的时间，如果诵得稍慢一点，则需要一个小时或以上。在背诵的过程中，如果这位比库有些忘记或诵错的地方，旁边的比库往往会提醒他，使他能流利地、准确无误地背诵下去。
It usually takes 35 to 50 minutes to recite Badimoca in its entirety, and it takes an hour or more if it is to be recited a little slower. In the rereading process, if this Biku has forgotten or was wrong, the next one will often remind him that he can recite it in a fluent and accurate manner.
四、回向
IV. RETURN
僧团在诵完巴帝摩卡後通常会做回向，回向的内容由各僧团（或派别）决定。斯里兰卡和缅甸的僧团多数以念诵《护卫经》或散播慈爱等为主，泰国僧团则多数会念些偈颂。做完回向之後，僧团长老通常还会利用僧众集会的因缘给予教诫。
The monks usually turn back when they finish the Pātimokkha, and what they turn back is decided by the monks (or sects). Most monks in Sri Lanka and Myanmar are mainly concerned with the reading of the Guardian or the spread of mercy, while most monks in Thailand recite hymns.
如果同住在一个界内的合格比库达到四位或四位以上，到诵戒日则应举行诵巴帝摩卡，因为四位比库即组成一个僧团(saṅgha)。如果只有两、三位比库共住，属于小众(gaṇa)，不用诵巴帝摩卡，只需作“清净伍波思特”(pārisuddhi-uposatha)。若只有一位比库独住，属于个人(puggala)，到了诵戒日只需作“决意伍波思特”(adhiṭṭhāna-uposatha)即可。具体的做法见本书 p.340-341。(V.3.168)
If you are living with a qualified Biku in a community of four or more, you should recite Batiamuka on the day of the recitation, because the four Bicus form a monks (sa gha). If only two or three Bicus live together, they belong to a small group (ga a) and do not read Batiamuka, but only “Pārisuddhi-uposatha.” If only one person lives alone and belongs to a person (puggala), only “decisively” Wubosta (adhi hāna-uposatha) is required on the day of the recitation.

巴拉基格诵

Tatrime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
于此，诵出此四巴拉基格法来。
These four rules on expulsion come up for recitation.
1. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ patiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāyapi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
1.若比库得到比库们之学和生活规则，未捨弃学，没表明羸弱而从事淫欲法者，乃至和畜生，也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk, after taking on the monks’ training and way of life, without first renouncing the training and revealing his weakness, has sexual intercourse, even with a female animal, he is expelled and excluded from the community.
2. Yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinnādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā corosi bālosi mūḷhosi thenosīti, tathārūpaṃ bhikkhu adinnaṃ ādiyamāno ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
2.若比库从村落或林野，以偷盗之心不与而取，因如何般不与取，诸王抓住盗贼後会打杀、捆缚或驱逐:“你是小偷、愚者、痴者、盗贼。”如此般不与而取的这比库也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk, intending to steal, takes from an inhabited area or from the wilderness what has not been given to him— the sort of stealing for which kings, having caught a thief, would beat, imprison, or banish him, saying, ‘You’re a bandit, you’re a fool, you’ve gone astray, you’re a thief’— he too is expelled and excluded from the community.
3. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya “ambho purisa kiṃ tuyhiminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, matante jīvitā seyyo”ti, iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya, ayampi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
3.若比库故意夺取人命，或为其寻找可取[命]的杀具，或赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死:“喂，男子！你为何以此悲惨地痛苦活着？你死了比活着更好!”如是心意、心思惟，用各种方法赞叹死亡的美好，或劝勉死，这也是巴拉基格，不共住。
If a monk intentionally kills a human being or seeks an instrument of death for them or praises death or incites someone to die, saying, ‘My friend, what’s the point of this miserable and difficult life? Death is better for you than life!’— thinking and intending thus, if he praises death in many ways or incites someone to die— he too is expelled and excluded from the community.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussa- dhammaṃ attūpanāyikaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanaṃ

桑喀地谢思诵

Ime kho panāyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
诸具寿，诵出此十三桑喀地谢思法来。
Venerables, these thirteen rules on suspension come up for recitation.
1. Sañcetanikā sukkavisaṭṭhi aññatra supinantā saṅghādiseso.
1.故意出精，除了梦中外，桑喀地谢思。
Intentional emission of semen, except while dreaming, is an offense entailing suspension.
2. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthagāhaṃ vā veṇigāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅghādiseso.
2.若比库以贪染、变易之心和女人发生身体相接触，或捉手，或捉发，或摩触任何部分者，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, makes physical contact with a woman—holding her hand or hair, or touching any part of her body—he commits an offense entailing suspension.
3. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methūnupasaṃhitāhi, saṅghādiseso.
3.若比库以贪染、变易之心对女人说粗俗语，犹如少男对少女[说]和淫欲相关者一样，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, speaks indecent words to a woman, as a young man might to a young woman and referring to sexual intercourse, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
4. Yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmassa santike attakāmapāricariyāya vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyya “etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā”ti methūnupasaṃhitena, saṅghādiseso.
4.若比库以贪染、变易之心在女人面前，赞叹以欲侍奉自己:“姐妹，若用此法来侍奉像我这样的持戒者、善法者、梵行者，这是诸侍奉中最高的。”和淫欲相关者，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk, overcome by lust and with a distorted mind, encourages a woman to satisfy his own desires, saying, ‘Sister, she provides the highest service who in this way satisfies one like me, who is virtuous, celibate, and of good character,’ and if it is a reference to sexual intercourse, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
5. Yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅkhaṇikāya'pi, saṅghādiseso.
5.若比库从事做媒，[传达]男子情意给女子，或女子情意给男子，而成为妻子或情人，乃至短暂关系，也桑喀地谢思。
If a monk acts as a matchmaker, conveying a man’s intention to a woman or a woman’s intention to a man, for marriage or for an affair, even if just a brief one, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
6. Saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatridaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ sattantarā, bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅghādiseso.
6.比库指定为自己建造自行乞求的无[施]主孤邸时，应适量而造。对此其量是：长为善至张手的十二张手，内部宽为七张。应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造自行乞求的孤邸，或未带领比库们指示地点，或超过量者，桑喀地谢思。
When a monk, by means of begging, builds a hut without a sponsoring owner and intended for himself, it is to be no more than twelve standard handspans long and seven wide inside. He must have monks approve a site where no harm will be done and which has space on all sides. If a monk, by means of begging, builds a hut on a site where harm will be done and which lacks space on all sides, or he does not have monks approve the site, or he exceeds the right size, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
7. Mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ attuddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ. Sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane mahallakaṃ vihāraṃ kāreyya, bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya, saṅghādiseso.
7.比库在为自己建造有[施]主的大住所时，应带领比库们指示地点，应由那些比库指示无侵害、有环绕空间的地点。假如比库在有侵害、无环绕空间的地点建造大住所，或未带领比库们指示地点者，桑喀地谢思。
When a monk builds a large dwelling with a sponsoring owner and intended for himself, he must have monks approve a site where no harm will be done and which has space on all sides. If a monk builds a large dwelling on a site where harm will be done and which lacks space on all sides, or he does not have monks approve the site, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
8. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā amūlakañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
8.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，用无根据的巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是毫无根据的，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk who is angry and displeased groundlessly charges a monk with an offense entailing expulsion, aiming to make him leave the monastic life, and then after some time, whether he is questioned or not, it is clear that the legal issue is groundless, and he admits to his ill will, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
9. Yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya “appeva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan”ti. tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañceva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅghādiseso.
9.若比库恶意、瞋恨、不满，取其它事情的某些部分类似之处，用巴拉基格法诽谤比库:“或许能使他从此梵行退堕。”从那之後的时间，[无论]被检问或没被检问，那案情只是取了其它部分的某些类似之处，且比库基于瞋恨，桑喀地谢思。
If a monk who is angry and displeased, uses an unrelated legal issue as a pretext to charge a monk with an offense entailing expulsion, aiming to make him leave the monastic life, and then after some time, whether he is questioned or not, it is clear that the legal issue is unrelated and was used as a pretext, and he admits to his ill will, he commits an offense entailing suspension.
10. Yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evamassa vacanīyo “mā āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi, sametāyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatī”ti, evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya, yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce paṭinissajjeyya, saṅghādiseso.
10.若比库致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。比库们要如此劝告那个比库:“请具寿不要致力于和合僧团的分裂，或受持、坚持导致分裂之事而住。请具寿与僧团和合，和合的僧团确实欢喜、无争、同一诵[戒]而安乐住！”那个比库被比库们如此劝告时，仍然那样坚持，比库们为了使那比库捨弃它，应乃至第三次劝谏。在乃至第三次劝谏时如果捨弃了它，这样很好。假如不捨弃，桑喀地谢思。
